# IRng

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public interface IRng
```

The single source of randomness a run consumes. An interface so a test can feed a fixed sequence, and so the generator cannot reach for `Random` by accident.
